scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @scout/web && npm run build --workspace @scout/worker
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run security:secrets && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @scout/web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler dev
scripts.dev:ai: npm run build --workspace @scout/web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler dev --env ai
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build --workspace @scout/web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build --workspace @scout/web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.migrate:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply scout-local --local
scripts.migrate:preview: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply scout-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.migrate:production: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply scout-production --remote --env production
scripts.test: npm run test:spike && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e:serve: npm run migrate:local && npm run dev
scripts.test:e2e:serve:isolated: npm run migrate:local && npm run build --workspace @scout/web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler dev --port 8790 --var OPS_ACCESS_TOKEN:e2e-operations-token-long-enough
